fixture.name: planted_team_size_contradiction
fixture.why: Two statements about the same migration that cannot both be true: led a team of four, and did it essentially alone.

expected_note: a2 claims a team of four under the candidate's leadership; a8 says the work was essentially solo with no help. Same project, same period, mutually exclusive. Both quotes must come back verbatim with turn ids a2 and a8. Latencies are naturally varied, so timing stays empty.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What was your title in that role?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Staff engineer, on the data platform team.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Tell me about the largest project you have worked on.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The warehouse migration, moving us off Redshift onto Snowflake. I led a team of four on the migration, and it ran about nine months end to end.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: About two hundred terabytes, though a lot of that was cold and we archived it rather than moving it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What was the hardest part of that migration?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The stored procedures. There were a few hundred of them and no test coverage, so we had to run both warehouses in parallel and diff the outputs for a month.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The Redshift contract renewal, so yes, a hard one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What did you learn from it?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: That the technical work is the easy half. Getting forty analysts to change their queries was harder than moving the data.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Were you still there when it finished?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, I stayed about six months after we cut over.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How did you divide up the work on that project?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Honestly it was mostly just me. I did not really have help on that one, everyone else was tied up on the reporting rewrite, so I picked it up and ground through it.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Start the query migration earlier and in parallel, rather than treating it as the last step.
